properties.selection_rationale: Equal-scale terrain window centered inside the Jezero CTX DEM coverage for the first controlled terrain experiment.
known_limitations: The window is not the whole crater or delta
Terrain alone does not represent Jezero geology or environment
properties.creation_method: Geodetic display footprint approximated from a 10 km square; processing constructs an exact metric grid around the center.
properties.planetary_target: Mars reference terrain window inside Jezero Crater.
properties.representativeness: Feature-focused reference window; it does not represent the complete Jezero Crater.
properties.known_selection_bias: The center is inherited from the project reference selection; independent geomorphology review is pending.
